Citation of Code

  1. The provisions herein adopted constitute the Spokane Municipal Code and any reference to the code, a title, chapter, division, article, section, or other subdivision, as such, is a sufficient citation for all purposes.
     
  2. The Spokane Municipal Code may be abbreviated and cited as “SMC.”
     
  3. Unless qualified by reference to a point in time or to a particular ordinance, any reference to this code includes the provision referenced and all amendments and additions thereto.

Date Passed: Monday, January 22, 2007

Effective Date: Sunday, March 4, 2007

Recodification ORD C33969 Section 1
